summary.text: Victoria Hunt represents Washington's 5th Legislative District in southeast King County in the state Senate. Her official biography says the King County Council appointed her to the Senate in June 2025 and that voters later elected her to a full term.

paragraphs.text: Hunt holds a bachelor's degree from Cornell University and a doctorate in ecology from the University of Illinois, according to her official biography.
It says her professional background includes work as a data scientist and climate policy expert at Breakthrough Energy, and as chief data officer at Crosswalk Labs.
Before the Legislature, the page says, she was elected to three terms on the Issaquah City Council and served as council president.

It says she was elected to the Washington House of Representatives in 2024, where she was vice chair of the House Environment and Energy Committee, and was unanimously appointed to the Senate by the King County Council in June 2025.
In the Senate she is Vice Chair of the Environment, Energy & Technology Committee and serves on the Transportation and Labor & Commerce committees, per the page.
It says she lives in Issaquah with her spouse and their two children.
